specialist.name: Fausta
specialist.finding: Hostinger reports correct configuration/authentication and attributes Spam classification to sender reputation; recommends low consistent expected sending and individual Not spam training.

fifthNativeTest.reasonForNewTest: Independent delayed-learning check almost two hours after the first own message was marked Not spam; no sending burst or mailbox-setting change. Waiting and one prior learning action have not yet proved automatic Inbox routing.

followup.scope: Reported fifth own test's saved/notified/Junk/authentication result, requested domain versus shared sending-IP reputation finding, safe supported action, unresolved allow-list semantics and formal email technical escalation if needed. Existing approved original headers referenced; no new complete-header packet transmitted.

bidirectionalTest.request: Specialist to send one ordinary marked email from an official Hostinger test address to info@promedical.lt, and provide that address for one non-sensitive test reply. Inspect only the exact requested marker in Inbox/Junk. No other user's account or customer data involved.

privacy: Only the new own marked test's minimal saved/notified/folder/authentication facts and public business addresses were discussed. No credentials, new full headers, unrelated mail or customer data transmitted. Own D1 query and telemetry were exact-marker/UUID-scoped read-only checks. Incoming external support test requested with a unique marker.
limits: New receiving mailbox, new sender domain and transport-server reputation are separate possibilities. Vendor attribution to reputation is recorded as vendor-reported, not independent proof of a particular signal.
Manual Not spam moves and server acceptance do not satisfy automatic Inbox acceptance.
No broad allow-list, filter loosening, spam disablement or DNS change. Other customer inbound mail must remain accepted. Wider security changes require specific owner action-time approval.
Existing failed receipts and historical mailbox records are preserved. Site recovery/rate/privacy/backup acceptance remains separate.
